shared_elements: animal in profile in low relief on a broad pillar face
quadruped/feline-like creature with elongated body and tail
long sinuous snake-like line running down the surface
relief carving on a rectangular upright stone face
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief animal figures in profile on the flat face of a tall rectangular pillar, and both include an elongated sinuous line/creature descending the face, which is a fairly specific shared convention of a single profile animal set against an otherwise plain field. However, B is a densely packed multi-register composition with rows of birds, a bucranium-like band, arms/hands, and stacked animals, while A shows only one isolated faint animal and a curving line, so the relationships and arrangement barely correspond.
